protocol.candidate_pool: 20 exact-validated Top20 submissions, four tapes each
protocol.distance: mean over six phases of 0.5 * L1 (total variation)

excluded_before_selection.reason: already represented by frozen V84 ryo_selector_family

protocol.fingerprint: pool raw farmer+all-hands+all-market operation counts over four tapes, then normalize each 120-step phase
protocol.medoid: per-tape normalized fingerprint minimizing mean total-variation distance to the other three; ties by episode_id then seat
protocol.selection: anchor best snapshot rank; repeatedly maximize minimum distance to selected; exact-distance ties prefer better snapshot rank
